testCases.title: Display Correct Category Page and Title
steps: Navigate to the category section of the application.
expectedResults: The correct category page is displayed.
The page title matches the clicked category name.

testCases.title: Match Filters on Category Page and Product Overview
steps: List all available filters on the category page.
Navigate to the product overview page.
List all available filters on the product overview page.
expectedResults: All filters available on the category page match those on the product overview.
